phase_3.key_finding: Corrected a transcription error inherited from the plan/report 01: Simpson's internalizing formula uses BOX (not diamond) as the outer ancestor-to-target telescoping connective, and DIAMOND (not box) for a subtree's own children -- exactly backwards from how the plan paraphrased it. Verified directly against the source PDF (Simpson_1994_IntuitionisticModalLogic.ocr.pdf, pages 109-112) via the Read tool (pdftotext garbles box/diamond glyphs in this typeface). This correction is what makes the 'combine' step for multi-premise rules (andI/impE/orE) tractable via ordinary K-necessitation reasoning (box is K-multiplicative; diamond is not) -- under the plan's incorrect reading, the analogous combine step would not be K-valid in general.
phase_3.remaining_obstruction: NIKAx.diaE's `z` parameter (the conclusion's label) is not scoped relative to `x` (the diamond-fact's label) by the bare Lean type. Simpson's own presentation enforces this via Fitch-style notational scoping, which does not automatically transfer to the inductive Prop encoding. Closing this requires (1) a separate, unproven well-scopedness invariant about NIKAx derivations, and (2) mechanizing Simpson's Figure 6-2 'dissection' tree-surgery argument for the case where z is a proper ancestor of x. Neither was completed this dispatch.

On paper (not yet mechanized as NIKAx induction cases): assumption/ax/efq/andI/andE1/andE2/orI1/orI2/impI/impE/boxE/boxI/diaI/orE all reduce cleanly to this toolkit; only diaE remains genuinely open.
